what: A blurred (7px) wave band 330px tall straddles the top edge of the section (132px into the section, 300px on phone), a one-period wave mask is tiled sideways and slid by one screen width every 8.2s (cubic-bezier(0,0,.9,.98) — it hesitates slightly at the end, then resumes). The band is scaled 1.2x and raised 3.125vw so its edges don’t show. This section’s background color ripples up like waves over the previous section (video · photo) to hand over

options.--fx-color: Band color (css variable), default var(--kf-raised) — gives this section’s background color
options.--fx-overlap: Depth at which the band enters the section, default 132px (1024px and up) · --fx-overlap-sm phone default 300px
options.--fx-period: Width of one wave cycle, default 1440px (screen width on phones)
options.--fx-dur: Length of one flow cycle, default 8.2s

note: The original scrolled wave.png (one wave period, 3840×886) as a background. The part redraws a similar wave as an SVG mask and fills it with the background color — change the skin and the band color follows. Since the band rises over the previous section, place it after the previous section (below it in document order) so it draws on top.

from.where: index.html .kt-map (video section → watercolor layout map) · .kt-travel (meal section → travel guide, 262px depth at 1366px and up) — original common.css .p-front__map:before·.p-front__travel:before
